method.description: Read-only postprocessing of existing qualification input/output bytes; no driver, kernel, or qualification run was executed.
method.gene_scale: max(1, max(abs(reference)) over rows); vectors use max(1, abs(reference gene))
method.relative_l2: maximum per-gene ||candidate-reference||2 / ||reference||2; zero-norm reference genes excluded and counted
method.ulp: maximum IEEE-754 ordered-bit distance for same-output-type backend comparisons; omitted for FP32-vs-FP64
method.grouping: maximum observed metric per stored profile, compute type, backend, quantity category across all applicable cases
method.gate_masks: All-gene summaries are unmasked. Original stochastic parameter/scale/objective gates apply valid status and condition masks; initial coefficients apply initialization masks. The original condition mask is not reconstructed here.

storage_quantization_vs_canonical_fp32.interpretation: storage quantization effect; not backend mismatch

limits: These maxima summarize the supplied fixtures, masks, configurations, and cases; they are not universal error bounds or a scientific-validity claim.
Same-input backend deviations and storage quantization effects are separate comparisons; FP32-vs-FP64 describes compute sensitivity only for FP32-stored input.

For FP32-vs-FP64, all-gene parameter/scale/objective maxima include genes excluded by the qualification gate masks; only full-coverage receipt fields are directly rechecked, and masked fields are counted separately.

The qualification receipt itself has pass_all=false because the independent source-oracle gate fails; backend, compute-precision, and explicit branch gates pass. This report does not reclassify that source comparison.
